weather_report:
The night draws gently to a close over Downtown San Francisco, cradled under a blanket of mostly cloudy skies. As the temperature nestles around a mild 58 degrees, a whisper of wind from the southwest begins to stir, promising change as the dawn approaches. With Sunday unfolding, the clouds will slowly surrender to a brilliant sun, turning the horizon into a canvas of warm light and tender hues. Expect the mercury to ascend towards a comfortable 73 degrees while the afternoon ushers in a slight coolness, as the temperature edges down to the mid-seventies, caressed by soft breezes that may dance with gusts up to 20 mph.

The view is poised to evolve from the muted greys of the overnight to an invigorating clarity that encourages a simple joy in exploration. With the fog retreating like a shy guest, the day beckons lovers of the outdoors. Dressing in layers is the key; a light sweater over a breathable tee will keep you comfortable as the sun peers through. Perhaps take a leisurely walk along the Embarcadero to watch the bay shimmer, or enjoy a quietly brewed coffee at a sidewalk café, where the world unfolds at a leisurely pace. The spirit of the day is peaceful yet inviting, a perfect canvas for the stories waiting to be written in the moments between us.
